inlines.v: VA'RIOLITE, noun [Latin varius and Gr. stone.] In mineralogy, a kind of porphyritic rock, in which the imbedded substances are imperfectly crystallized, or are rounded, giving the stone a spotted appearance. Variolites are fragments of primitive gladular rocks.
